user.title: Cloudflare Workers AI
user.description: Connect a Cloudflare account to use Workers AI for speech-to-text and text-to-speech.

data_description.account_id: Cloudflare account ID, shown in the Cloudflare dashboard.
data_description.api_token: Cloudflare API token with Workers AI permissions.
data_description.use_gateway: Route requests through Cloudflare AI Gateway.
data_description.gateway_id: Name of the AI Gateway. Required when AI Gateway is enabled.
data_description.gateway_token: Token for an authenticated AI Gateway. Leave empty for a gateway without authentication.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Cloudflare Workers AI
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for account {account_id} was rejected. Enter a new API token.

data_description.api_token: Cloudflare API token with Workers AI permissions.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Cloudflare Workers AI
reconfigure.description: Update the API token and AI Gateway settings. The account ID must remain the same.

data_description.account_id: Cloudflare account ID, shown in the Cloudflare dashboard.
data_description.api_token: Cloudflare API token with Workers AI permissions.
data_description.use_gateway: Route requests through Cloudflare AI Gateway.
data_description.gateway_id: Name of the AI Gateway. Required when AI Gateway is enabled.
data_description.gateway_token: Token for an authenticated AI Gateway. Leave empty for a gateway without authentication.

error.invalid_auth: The API token is invalid or lacks the required permissions.
error.gateway_id_required: The gateway ID is required when AI Gateway is enabled.

abort.already_configured: This Cloudflare account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The account ID must match the one already configured.

init.title: Models and voice
init.description: Select the speech-to-text model, the text-to-speech model and the voice. The voice list belongs to the saved text-to-speech model; after changing the model, the voice is validated against the new model.

data_description.stt_model: Whisper model used to transcribe speech.
data_description.stt_initial_prompt: Optional text with names or terms that help the transcription. Leave empty for none.
data_description.tts_model: Aura model used to synthesize speech.
data_description.tts_voice: Voice of the selected Aura model.

error.invalid_voice: The voice is not available for the selected text-to-speech model.
